text: キャハハ　また　きたって　おなじよ　かるく　ひとひねり　してやるわ！

structure.jp: また　きたって　おなじよ
structure.en: even if you come again, it'll be the same

structure.jp: かるく　ひとひねり　してやるわ！

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: たって is the casual spoken form of ても, 'even if'. また　きたって = 'even if you come again'.

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.span: ひとひねり　してやる
patterns.explanation: てやる after a verb says you will do it to someone, here with a cocky, threatening ring. ひとひねり　してやる = 'I'll make short work of you'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end gives a feminine firmness to what the speaker says. してやるわ = 'I'll do it to you!'.
